title: Guard receipt and shipment cancellation while approved returns remain
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Authorized source shipment/receipt cancellation must check explicit live effective approved SalesReturn.SourceStockOutId and PurchaseReturn.SourceStockInId evidence before inventory reversal or state changes. Reject source cancellation with an actionable return reversal requirement; preserve all original document/details/status/stock/ledger on denial. Null-source unrelated returns do not block. Do not alter financial allocation history or infer references from numbers.

Use the same upstream document row lock and atomic transaction as linked return approval/unaudit, with deterministic lock order. Two independent connections racing return approval against source cancellation admit only one consistent outcome. Reversed/cancelled return allows the existing source workflow; repeat source cancel remains idempotent under existing rules. Maintain live existing user/menu/data scope, no business grants; execute actual source and return controllers/services in isolated real SQL tests and retain old movement/fulfillment assertions.
